name: hound-wasp-squeeze
description: Combination stage of the houndframe trial (?hound=2, the frozen CP2 baseline). Same route and terrain jump as hound-grounded.json, with the dodge jump at 1230ms - measured SAFE against the lone houndframe and punished every run once a wasp cruises the arc over its plate, by the dive rather than the charge (frame-accurate attribution: wasp/dive at y~4.8, airborne). That narrowing is the combination: DESIGN's 'hound forces the jump that the wasp contests', measured rather than asserted. A perfectly timed dodge (1280-1330ms) still clears both, so the squeeze is a window mastery can thread, not a wall.
